# `//third_party/rust/icu4x_data`

This directory contains pre-generated ICU4X baked data macros for Chromium,
analogous to `//third_party/icu`'s per-platform ICU4C `.dat` bundles. See
[go/icu4x-chromium-data-strategy](http://go/icu4x-chromium-data-strategy) for
the overall design and data strategy.

Because ICU4X's `BakedExporter` (with `use_separate_crates = false`) emits
`macro_rules!` definitions (`make_provider!` and `impl_<marker>!`) that are
expanded inside each downstream `icu_<component>` crate when `compiled_data` is
enabled, `//third_party/rust/icu4x_data:lib` has zero crate dependencies in
`BUILD.gn` and unreferenced data markers incur zero compile-time or binary-size
cost.

## Directory Layout

- `BUILD.gn`: Defines `//third_party/rust/icu4x_data:lib`, selecting the target
  platform's data bundle via `--cfg=icu4x_data_platform_<platform>` (mirroring
  `//third_party/icu/BUILD.gn`, overridable via the `icu4x_override_data_dir`
  GN arg).
- `sources.gni`: Auto-generated lists of `.rs.data` and `mod.rs` inputs per
  platform for GN dependency tracking.
- `src/lib.rs`: Exports `cldr_tag!`, `unicode_tag!`, and `segmenter_lstm_tag!`
  and `include!`s `data/<platform>/mod.rs` at the crate root.
- `src/data/<platform>/`: Baked `.rs.data` files and `mod.rs` for each of the
  8 ICU filter platforms (`common`, `chromeos`, `android`, `ios`, `cast`,
  `chromecast_video`, `flutter`, `flutter_desktop`). Any `.rs.data` file in a
  non-`common` platform that is byte-for-byte identical to `src/data/common/`
  is deduplicated and referenced via `include!("../common/<file>.rs.data")`.
- `patches/`: Unified `.patch` files applied to pristine `ICU4X-json` payloads
  before baking when listed under `patches = [...]` in
  `//tools/crates/icu4x_datagen/config.toml` (see
  [`patches/README.md`](patches/README.md) for correspondences with
  `//third_party/icu/patches/`).

## Regenerating Data

The files in this directory are generated by
`//tools/crates/run_icu4x_datagen.py` (which builds and runs
`//tools/crates/icu4x_datagen`, configured by
`//tools/crates/icu4x_datagen/config.toml` and
`//third_party/icu/filters/*.json`).

From the Chromium `src/` root:

```bash
# Regenerate all 8 platforms using //third_party/icu/filters/*.json and
# //tools/crates/icu4x_datagen/config.toml (including the patches listed in
# `patches = [...]`):
python3 tools/crates/run_icu4x_datagen.py generate

# Regenerate a single platform (e.g. common) for local iteration ONLY.
# Do NOT commit the output of a partial `--platforms` run: non-selected
# platforms' `mod.rs` files `include!("../common/<file>.rs.data")` and are only
# re-deduplicated when all 8 platforms are generated together.
python3 tools/crates/run_icu4x_datagen.py generate --platforms common

# Inspect how //third_party/icu/filters/*.json map to ICU4X filter categories:
python3 tools/crates/run_icu4x_datagen.py inspect-filters

# List all registered ICU4X markers and their default filter categories:
python3 tools/crates/run_icu4x_datagen.py list-markers

# Dump pristine ICU4X-json payloads to inspect or author a new patch:
python3 tools/crates/run_icu4x_datagen.py dump-json \
  --json-dir /tmp/icu4x_json \
  --markers locale/names/language/medium/tiny/v1 \
  --locales ay wa

# Run unit tests for //tools/crates/icu4x_datagen:
python3 tools/crates/run_icu4x_datagen.py test
```

## Wiring `icu_*_data` Crates via `gnrt`

To redirect upstream `icu_*_data` crates in `//third_party/rust` to
`//third_party/rust/icu4x_data:lib`, set `replace_with` in
`//third_party/rust/chromium_crates_io/gnrt_config.toml`:

```toml
[crate.icu_calendar_data]
replace_with = "//third_party/rust/icu4x_data:lib"
```

Then run both `vendor` and `gen`:

```bash
# Replaces vendored `icu_*_data` crates with tiny placeholders and removes
# stale `//third_party/rust/icu_*_data/<epoch>/` directories:
python3 tools/crates/run_gnrt.py vendor

# Regenerates downstream `BUILD.gn` dependencies to point at
# `//third_party/rust/icu4x_data:lib`:
python3 tools/crates/run_gnrt.py gen
```
